module: Initialization of the graphics client (port of Torque's client.cs). initClient prepares rendering (postFx, renderManager, lighting systems), creates the GameViewportCtrl "OnlyGui" and CefGui "maincef" controls (web interface), loads the datablocks (core/art/datablocks, art, assets) then shows the main menu. reloadClient only reloads the lighting systems and post-effects.
notes: The name "maincef" must not change: it is hardcoded on the C++ side (code comment). Its start URL is local://local/ui/entrypoints/main/index.html.
With the command-line argument -noui, GameViewportCtrl is not created.
If the graphics adapter is "GFX Null Device", PostFX initialization is skipped (error logged).
With -convertCSMaterials, the datablock folders are not loaded.
$defaultLevelEnviromentMap is set to BNG_Sky_02_cubemap (default cubemap for levels without globalEnviromentMap).

initClient.desc: Full client initialization sequence: base rendering, GUI controls, datablocks, audioData.cs if it exists, then loadMainMenu.

loadMainMenu.desc: Shows the "OnlyGui" control as the canvas content (main menu), if both objects exist.

reloadClient.desc: Reloads the lighting systems and post-effects (reloadLightingSystems, reloadPostEffects), useful after a graphics configuration change.
